content.short: Levr Bet offers prediction markets on sports with 2x to 5x leverage on single-game lines.
content.description: Levr Bet applies two to five times leverage to sports prediction markets on Monad, letting participants take amplified positions on single-game lines. A settled line pays out in full or not at all, so there is no gradual slide toward a liquidation price as there would be on a price-based perpetual. Positions are collateralised and settle when the game resolves.
content.meta: Levr Bet adds 2x to 5x leverage to single-game sports prediction markets on Monad, with collateralised positions that settle when the game ends.
